panels.title: Freshness Status
panels.description: LIVE only when source->DB lag and MV freshness are healthy and dead letters are zero.

targets.rawSql:
WITH health AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(lag_seconds), 0)::bigint AS shipper_lag_seconds,
         coalesce(sum(unresolved_dead_letters), 0)::bigint AS unresolved_dead_letters
  FROM ops.platform_health_v
), src AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(observed_at))::bigint AS source_age_seconds,
         extract(epoch FROM now() - max(ingested_at))::bigint AS db_lag_seconds
  FROM raw.ingested_event
), mv AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - coalesce(max(day), now()))::bigint AS mv_age_seconds
  FROM signal.intelligence_daily_mv
)
SELECT CASE WHEN greatest(
  coalesce((SELECT shipper_lag_seconds FROM health), 0),
  coalesce((SELECT db_lag_seconds FROM src), 0),
  coalesce((SELECT mv_age_seconds FROM mv), 0)
) > 300 OR coalesce((SELECT unresolved_dead_letters FROM health), 0) > 0
THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS value

WITH health AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(lag_seconds), 0)::bigint AS shipper_lag_seconds,
         coalesce(sum(unresolved_dead_letters), 0)::bigint AS unresolved_dead_letters
  FROM ops.platform_health_v
), src AS (
  SELECT max(observed_at) AS latest_source_event,
         max(ingested_at) AS latest_db_ingest,
         extract(epoch FROM now() - max(ingested_at))::bigint AS db_lag_seconds
  FROM raw.ingested_event
), mv AS (
  SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - coalesce(max(day), now()))::bigint AS mv_age_seconds
  FROM signal.intelligence_daily_mv
)
SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       coalesce((SELECT shipper_lag_seconds FROM health), 0) AS shipper_lag_seconds,
       coalesce((SELECT db_lag_seconds FROM src), 0) AS db_lag_seconds,
       coalesce((SELECT mv_age_seconds FROM mv), 0) AS mv_age_seconds,
       coalesce((SELECT unresolved_dead_letters FROM health), 0) AS unresolved_dead_letters,
       (SELECT latest_source_event FROM src) AS latest_source_event,
       (SELECT latest_db_ingest FROM src) AS latest_db_ingest

SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       coalesce(max(nullif(payload->>'production_sha', '')), 'UNAVAILABLE') AS production_sha,
       coalesce(max(nullif(payload->>'analytics_sha', '')), 'UNAVAILABLE') AS analytics_sha,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(sha256), 'UNAVAILABLE') FROM ops.schema_version) AS schema_sha
FROM raw.ingested_event
WHERE observed_at > now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT to_stage AS metric, count(*)::bigint AS value
FROM lifecycle.stage_transition
WHERE occurred_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY to_stage
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT day AS time,
       outcome AS metric,
       sum(evaluations)::bigint AS value
FROM market.attrition_daily_mv
WHERE day > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY day, outcome
ORDER BY day

SELECT now() AS observed_at, gate_name, reason_code, sum(transitions)::bigint AS transitions
FROM lifecycle.rejection_mix_daily_mv
WHERE day > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY gate_name, reason_code
ORDER BY transitions DESC
LIMIT 40

SELECT day AS time,
       directional_evaluations,
       captured_winners,
       executable_false_negatives,
       threshold_70_79_miss_candidates,
       ranking_or_cap_miss_candidates,
       operational_executable_misses
FROM learning.opportunity_accountability_daily_mv
WHERE day > now() - interval '60 days'
ORDER BY day

SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       coalesce(sum(directional_evaluations), 0)::bigint AS directional_evaluations,
       coalesce(sum(completed_forward_outcomes), 0)::bigint AS matured_forward_outcomes,
       coalesce(sum(captured_winners), 0)::bigint AS captured_winners,
       coalesce(sum(executable_false_negatives), 0)::bigint AS executable_false_negatives,
       CASE WHEN coalesce(sum(market_winner_candidates), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE round(100.0 * sum(captured_winners) / sum(market_winner_candidates), 2)
       END AS capture_rate_pct,
       round(coalesce(sum(estimated_missed_move_pct_sum), 0), 4) AS estimated_missed_move_pct
FROM learning.opportunity_accountability_daily_mv

SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED'))::bigint AS open_trades,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED'))::bigint AS closed_trades,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED') AND coalesce(realised_pnl,0) > 0)::bigint AS wins,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED') AND coalesce(realised_pnl,0) <= 0)::bigint AS losses,
       CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED')) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED') AND coalesce(realised_pnl,0) > 0)
                 / count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED')), 2)
       END AS win_rate_pct,
       round(coalesce(sum(realised_pnl) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED')), 0), 8) AS realised_pnl,
       round(avg(realised_pnl) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('CLOSED', 'SETTLED')), 8) AS average_return
FROM paper.trade
WHERE coalesce(closed_at, opened_at, now()) > now() - interval '30 days'

SELECT c.decision_at AS observed_at,
       i.canonical_asset AS symbol,
       c.direction,
       c.decision,
       c.terminal_reason_code,
       c.strategy_version,
       c.model_version,
       c.config_version
FROM lifecycle.candidate c
LEFT JOIN market.instrument i ON i.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
ORDER BY c.decision_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT date_trunc('day', observed_at) AS time,
       count(*)::bigint AS feature_snapshots
FROM learning.feature_snapshot
WHERE observed_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', first_seen_at) AS time,
       stream_name || ':' || error_type AS metric,
       count(*)::bigint AS value
FROM ops.dead_letter
WHERE first_seen_at > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_decision AS (
  SELECT day,
         mean_decision_latency_ms,
         decision_latency_samples
  FROM learning.opportunity_accountability_daily_mv
  ORDER BY day DESC
  LIMIT 1
), health AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(lag_seconds), 0)::bigint AS ingest_lag_seconds,
         coalesce(sum(unresolved_dead_letters), 0)::bigint AS unresolved_dead_letters
  FROM ops.platform_health_v
)
SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       (SELECT day FROM latest_decision) AS latest_decision_day,
       (SELECT mean_decision_latency_ms FROM latest_decision) AS latest_mean_decision_latency_ms,
       (SELECT decision_latency_samples FROM latest_decision) AS latest_decision_samples,
       (SELECT ingest_lag_seconds FROM health) AS current_ingest_lag_seconds,
       (SELECT unresolved_dead_letters FROM health) AS unresolved_dead_letters

WITH health AS (
  SELECT coalesce(max(lag_seconds), 0)::bigint AS max_ingest_lag_seconds
  FROM ops.platform_health_v
)
SELECT now() AS observed_at,
       '<60% disk healthy; 70% warn; 80% urgent' AS disk_policy,
       '<70% memory healthy; >80% sustained investigate' AS memory_policy,
       '>75% sustained CPU investigate' AS cpu_policy,
       '<2m ingest target; >5m warning' AS ingest_policy,
       '<2m dashboard target; >5m stale' AS dashboard_policy,
       (SELECT max_ingest_lag_seconds FROM health) AS max_ingest_lag_seconds

SELECT date_trunc('day', observed_at) AS time,
       avg((payload->>'archive_bytes')::numeric) AS archive_bytes
FROM raw.ingested_event
WHERE observed_at > now() - interval '30 days'
  AND coalesce(payload->>'archive_bytes', '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.decision_at AS observed_at,
       i.canonical_asset AS symbol,
       s.scanner_type,
       c.direction,
       st.gate_name,
       st.reason_code,
       c.strategy_version,
       c.model_version,
       c.config_version,
       c.decision
FROM lifecycle.candidate c
LEFT JOIN market.instrument i ON i.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN market.screening s ON s.scan_id = c.scan_id AND s.instrument_id = c.instrument_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT gate_name, reason_code
  FROM lifecycle.stage_transition t
  WHERE t.candidate_id = c.candidate_id
  ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) st ON true
WHERE (${symbol:singlequote} = '__all' OR i.canonical_asset IN (${symbol:singlequote}))
  AND (${strategy:singlequote} = '__all' OR c.strategy_version IN (${strategy:singlequote}))
  AND (${scanner:singlequote} = '__all' OR coalesce(s.scanner_type, 'NONE') IN (${scanner:singlequote}))
  AND (${direction:singlequote} = '__all' OR c.direction IN (${direction:singlequote}))
  AND (${gate_reason:singlequote} = '__all' OR coalesce(st.reason_code, 'NONE') IN (${gate_reason:singlequote}))
  AND (${model_version:singlequote} = '__all' OR coalesce(c.model_version, 'NONE') IN (${model_version:singlequote}))
  AND (${config_version:singlequote} = '__all' OR coalesce(c.config_version, 'NONE') IN (${config_version:singlequote}))
  AND c.decision_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY c.decision_at DESC
LIMIT 500

list.name: model_version
